notes.title: Achievements rewards, language selection change and small translation changes.
notes.content:
Ultimate Solid v1.1.5 is now live!

What's new in this version:
[list]
[*] [fix] Achievements synchronization. All deserved achievements will be granted automatically even if you completed the game before the Steam Achievements were added to Ultimate Solid.

[*] [change] The language is now set automatically. You no longer have to select the language each time you start the game. You can still change the language by clicking the country icon in the main menu.

[*] [fix] Small changes to French and Slovenian translations.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Cards, Steam Achievements and multi-language support!
notes.content:
Ultimate Solid v1.1.0 is now live!

What's new in this version:
[list]
[*] [new] Added Steam Trading Cards
[*] [new] Added Steam Achievements
[*] [new] Added 11 languages support (including Serbian and Slovenian which are not listed by default on Steam)
[*] [fix] The problem with recording/streaming the gameplay has been fixed
[*] [fix] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

More languages will be added soon!
